purpose: One section Activity Options hub exposes approved participation structures around two full 24-question canonical routes; Activities change participation, not the mathematics.

dashboard_behavior.meaning: Activity Options hub, not one AI-selected activity format

canonical_source: finalized Unit Bank machine-readable data/routing + canonical figures/answers

question_sets.selection_rule: Use ALL 24 canonical items from the finalized Bank Practice Set 2 route for Set 1 and ALL 24 from Practice Set 3 for Set 2. Do not curate a shorter subset or rewrite mathematics.

approved_options.desmos_rule: Directions/link option only unless a real teacher/Framework source is supplied; never fabricate a Desmos activity/link.
approved_options.tarsia_rule: Hub may link to existing Practice-owned Tarsia/generator route; Activities do not create a second Tarsia export.

hub.role: Activity Options menu + approved directions + companion links

projection.reuse: same canonical set used by all projection participation options
projection.dom_order: prompt text first, then supporting table/graph/figure
projection.table_rule: ordinary small/two-column data tables use compact centered sizing; never stretch full-page by default

find_someone_who.reuse: same canonical set in printable movement/peer-interaction worksheet

source_exclusions: Practice-owned Tarsia export as newly generated Activity content

closure.rule: Do not append Activity Check/Exit Ticket by default. Optional formative closure only if explicitly requested/authorized.

figures: Copy finalized Bank figure bytes exactly into the section figures/ folder when referenced. Do not regenerate in ordinary Activities build.
graph_tool: Do not invoke or package for ordinary Activities builds.
student_metadata: No visible Bank IDs, I-can codes, DOK, structure IDs, evidence metadata, or generator labels.
teacher_live: Preserve teacher-live hubs/companions on later rebuilds unless explicitly replaced.

hub_internal_links.activity_name_rule: Every activity name on the first page links to a same-document projectable directions anchor in u{U}_{S}_act1.html.
hub_internal_links.set_link_rule: Set 1 / Set 2 links remain beside the activity name and point to the reusable projection or printable companion files as applicable.
